project: CE 393 Plate No. 2 - Proposed Two-Storey Residential Building
revision: Reference layout revision 01 + area-budget coordination revision 02; dimensioned footprint pending
assumptions: Phase 3 Revision 04 budgets the ground floor at 73.32 m2 programmed clear area including a proposed 3.00 x 5.50 m enclosed garage, and the second floor at 66.01 m2 programmed clear area with only one combined Toilet and bath upstairs. The separate Bathroom and Toilet previously shown upstairs are removed by the user's decision. Clear-space area released by those removals is not allocated to another room yet.

The 15% gross-up (net area / 0.85) is a rough planning allowance only, not a code factor. Current gross-area proxies are 86.26 m2 ground floor, 77.66 m2 second floor and 163.92 m2 total; final floor areas require dimensioned drawings and consistent treatment of garage, stair opening, walls and balcony.

The current 9.30 x 7.90 m main rectangle and separate carport placement are legacy geometry from the earlier simple layout. They have not been regenerated to the revised room arrangement or the new area budget and must not be treated as an accepted footprint.

Local Palo zoning classification and parcel-specific front-yard/ROW setbacks have not been confirmed. The uniform 2.00 m inward-offset polygon and 90% corner-lot occupancy calculation are screening scenarios only, not a building permit or verified local zoning result.

The furnished A-02 and A-03 reference-layout previews supersede the earlier simple room-box diagrams for visual arrangement. The reference images do not supply reliable room dimensions, so these layouts use diagram units only and must not be treated as scaled or dimensioned construction plans.

The older building.rooms target boxes are retained as provisional planning data until room areas and dimensions are reconciled with the revised visual layout. Do not assume the legacy room boxes describe the new drawing geometry.
The adjusted Phase 1 traverse is an academic plotting basis, not cadastral certification.

The 2.00 m uniform inward offset is a screening illustration based on the general Group A dwelling text in PD 1096 Section 708(a); applicable local zoning, R-1 table conditions, road ROW limits, firewalls and greater setbacks have not been confirmed.
Ground finished-floor elevation is ±0.000 m and second finished-floor elevation is +3.000 m, matching the Phase 4 assumed rise; both require instructor confirmation.
The 9.30 m x 7.90 m rectangular house is a concept footprint, not a verified compliant building footprint.
The single-car 2.80 m x 5.50 m covered carport and its position are schematic; final access, turning, gate and road-opening position are unresolved.
Doors, windows, finishes, ceiling/eaves/roof levels and roof pitch are draft design targets, not confirmed code minima.
No structural member sizing, reinforcement, foundation design, detailed utilities, permit compliance or construction instruction is included.

Phase 3 Revision 04 (2026-10-12): retain the combined upstairs Toilet and bath, remove the separate upstairs Bathroom and Toilet, and retain the ground-floor Toilet and bath. The released 4.95 m2 is an unallocated design reserve until the measured layout is coordinated.

User reference layout revision 02 (2026-10-12): the lower upper-floor zone is gym on the left, family area on the right, stairway along the upper-right edge, and a balcony projecting from the bottom edge near the center of the overall footprint, reached directly from the family area. This is an arrangement reference only, not dimension data.

limitations: These numbers are a design budget, not final C-06/C-07/C-08 calculation results.

All footprints must be geometrically inside the final approved envelope, not merely below an area cap.
Check actual road/ROW lines, local zoning class, frontages, setbacks, driveway and building orientation.
Recalculate areas from the dimensioned final plans; confirm how the stairwell void, enclosed garage and balcony are measured.
Revision 04 removes the separate upstairs Bathroom and Toilet. The 4.95 m2 released from their provisional targets is not reassigned to another space before the dimensioned layout is coordinated.
